---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for StashSnip
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: feature
assignees: ''
---

.✦ ݁˖**What's the problem this solves?**

Describe the actual pain point first, not just the feature  e.g. "I can't find a
snippet by its code, only by title" rather than jumping straight to "add full-text
search." This helps figure out if there's a simpler fix than what you have in mind.

.✦ ݁˖**Describe the feature you'd like**

What you'd want to happen, as concretely as you can.

.✦ ݁˖**Any alternatives you've considered**

If you thought about other ways to solve the same problem, mention them here, even
if you ended up preferring this one.

.✦ ݁˖**Are you open to working on this yourself?**

Let us know if you'd like to pick this up. Happy to discuss scope/approach in the
comments before anyone starts coding.
